notes: v1.0.31 — CRITICAL FIX: the Update button was broken for v1.0.30 (it did nothing on 2 PCs). Root cause: the v1.0.30 manifest dropped the installer field the client requires, so the packaged launcher silently fell back to the whole-repository codeload zip (wrong artifact, slow/blocked host) — the download never completed and install() rejected it (not an exe). Fix: (1) the manifest now declares the asset BOTH as installer path and direct url; (2) the updater resolves the asset from installer OR a direct asset url, and on a packaged install with no asset it disables the button with a clear log instead of silently downloading the repo zip; (3) the downloaded installer is now SHA-256 verified against the manifest — a corrupt/partial/tampered file is deleted and the update cancelled loudly; (4) download start is logged (real network call confirmed). Existing v1.0.30 users were already unblocked by the hotfix manifest commit (d12fd7a).
